hero.title: Connect with Nearby Hosts and Find Budget-Friendly Stays on
hero.description: Trawise is a mobile travel application that connects travelers with local accommodation hosts through a location-based request system. Users can set their desired location and budget on an interactive map, create accommodation requests with specific dates and preferences, and receive responses from nearby hosts.
hero.scrollHint: See how it works for hotels

forHotels.title: How Trawise Works for Hotels
forHotels.subtitle: Fill your empty rooms for the closest dates by connecting directly with nearby travelers.

step1.title: Register your hotel
step1.description: Create a host account and enter your hotel's basic details, or email us and we'll set it up for you.

step2.title: Receive requests
step2.description: View requests from nearby travelers and choose the ones that work best for you.

step3.title: Compare and decide
step3.description: Compare each traveler's price, dates, and rating to make an informed decision.

step4.title: Accept and welcome
step4.description: Accept your chosen request and welcome the traveler on their arrival date.

benefit1.title: Fill your last-minute vacancies
benefit1.description: Turn empty rooms into bookings for the closest dates, with no long-term commitment.

benefit2.title: Free for hotels
benefit2.description: Joining Trawise and listing your hotel costs nothing — there are no fees to get started.

benefit3.title: An extra marketing channel
benefit3.description: Reach travelers actively searching nearby, without spending on ads or promotions.

footer.description: Connect with nearby hosts and find budget-friendly stays on Trawise

comingSoon.title: Coming Soon to Your App Store
comingSoon.description: We're putting the finishing touches on the Trawise mobile app. Soon you'll be able to connect with nearby hosts and find budget-friendly stays right from your smartphone.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.introMessage: We're sorry to see you go. You can delete your account in two ways:

viaAppSettings.title: Via App Settings
viaAppSettings.description: Go to Settings > Delete Account to remove your data instantly.

requestHere.title: Request Here or by Email
requestHere.description: If you prefer, email us and we'll process your deletion request manually.
